rollback_or_rollforward: Reversible: downgrade drops the tenant-isolation RLS policies (and disables FORCE/RLS) on every northstar_learning table, then drops profile_feature, credential, completion_rule, attempt, assessment_item, overlay, progress, course, learning_path, domain and the northstar_learning schema (CASCADE). progress, attempt, credential and overlay hold learner records and completion evidence, so on a shared environment export the schema first (uninstall policy export_then_delete) and restore from the pre-migration backup rather than dropping in place.

prechecks: database is a supported PostgreSQL version
postchecks: northstar_learning schema with domain, learning_path, course, progress, overlay, assessment_item, attempt, completion_rule, credential and profile_feature tables exists
row-level security is enabled and forced on every northstar_learning table with a tenant-isolation policy keyed to the northstar.tenant_id GUC

compatibility_window: Phase 6 learning & assessment module (JRN-001 reference product core): hierarchy over published knowledge revisions, progress independent from analytics with stable resume, private overlay, versioned immutable assessment items with deterministic scoring, completion & credentials from explicit rules over auditable evidence, explainable consent/entitlement-aware recommendations, transparent inferred profile, and a multilingual AI tutor reusing ai.answer baseline
